item.title: Scientists reveal 93% of Australia's Indigenous population was lost in just 73 years
item.description: A groundbreaking study suggests that 2.22 million Indigenous Australians lived on the continent before European colonization, far more than previously believed. Researchers estimate that 93% of this population was lost within 73 years, revealing a demographic catastrophe on a scale that dramatically changes our understanding of Australian history. Fuente: ScienceDaily.

item.title: Australian court orders bamboo removal after roots block neighbour’s sewer, awards A$6,253 in damages
item.description: In a landmark decision, an Australian court addressed a bamboo dispute affecting two neighboring properties in New South Wales. The court determined that the bamboo created a blockage and posed a risk for future damage to the sewer line. As a result, Homes NSW was ordered to compensate A$6,253.50 for previous treatment costs. The ruling highlights the importance of communication and diligent records for homeowners facing similar issues. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
